verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack describes an explicit sandbox/staging environment or test-mode that isolates AI agent testing from production data; the closest items (local OSS quickstart, PyAirbyte for prototyping in Jupyter, multiple workspaces) address local deployment or workspace separation but never frame it as a sandbox to prevent touching production data. The axis is plausible for a data platform (workspaces, dev/test connections) but remains unevidenced.
